hooks.command: cd /home/sharaths/projects/PWM && source /home/sharaths/vllm-env/bin/activate && changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep '\.py$' | head -8); [ -z "$changed" ] && exit 0; echo "[hook] py_compile check..."; echo "$changed" | xargs python -m py_compile 2>&1 && echo "[hook] syntax OK" || echo "[hook] SYNTAX ERROR — fix before committing"

cd /home/sharaths/projects/PWM && file=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep 'tests/test_' | head -1); [ -z "$file" ] && exit 0; echo "[hook] Test file modified — running suite..."; source /home/sharaths/vllm-env/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/ -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /home/sharaths/projects/PWM && unpushed=$(git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$unpushed" -gt 4 ] && echo "[hook] WARNING: $unpushed unpushed commits on main — remember to push (CLAUDE.md §3: push every 3-5 commits)" || true
